messages:
maria: Quick question — I'm adding logging for /v1/serve/predict in staging. We need enough info to debug routing/latency but must avoid logging PII. Current plan: redact email addresses + phone numbers from request/response bodies, HMAC the user_id (server-side secret), and keep a truncated prompt preview (first 100 chars) AFTER redaction. Store logs in encrypted S3 for 7 days in staging. Any immediate objections or policy caveats? cc @devon

devon: Short answer: good instincts. A few notes: 1) Never log raw auth tokens or full prompts containing unredacted PII. 2) HMAC (server-side secret) is acceptable for IDs — use a rotation scheme and record key id in metadata. 3) Truncated preview is fine but only after redaction. 4) 7 days staging retention is ok; prod needs shorter retention + stricter access. Open a PR and tag sec for review. :thumbsup:

oliver: Implementation tip: use HMAC-SHA256 + base64url to avoid odd chars in logs. Example (py):
```
import hmac, hashlib, base64

def hmac_id(secret, id_str):
    digest = hmac.new(secret.encode(), id_str.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(digest).decode().rstrip('=')
```
Store the key id alongside the hashed id so we can rotate. Also, redact before truncation.

maria: Thanks. One question: for prompt preview, should we run the email/phone regex and replace with <REDACTED> before truncating? Or hash the whole prompt and keep only hashed value + preview? Concerned about collisions if we hash long variable text.

devon: Do regex-based redaction first (emails, phones, SSNs, credit card patterns). Then store: {hashed_user_id, prompt_preview, redaction_version, key_id}. Hash user id only (not entire prompt). Prompt preview should be normalized (whitespace collapse) and limited to 64 chars ideally. Also add a flag 'contains_pii': true/false set during redaction pass.

sec-bot: [policy-bot] Excerpt from PII Logging Policy v2.1: "Do not log raw authentication tokens, credentials, or unredacted personal data (emails, phones, SSNs). Allowed: one-way hashes/HMACs, truncated redacted previews, and environment-specific retention rules. All logging of request/response bodies must be approved by eng-security for prod. See https://internal.redwood/policies/pii-logging"

maria: OK I'll implement HMAC-SHA256 for user_id, run the redactor over request/response, store preview=first_64_chars_post_redaction, set retention=7d for staging, and open PR with tests + sample sanitized log lines. Will tag you both. Thanks! :raised_hands:

oliver: SGTM. When you open the PR, include a small migration script to backfill hashed ids for recent staging logs we might need for debugging. Happy to review.

devon: Thanks — once PR is up I'll do a quick policy review. Also add a config toggle so we can turn off previews if needed.

maria: Will do. PR coming in a few hours.
